t: This is the place linked with the Society for Effecting the Abolition of the Slave Trade, a British abolitionist group formed on the twenty-second of May, seventeen eighty-seven. Its founders included Thomas Clarkson, Granville Sharp, and several Quakers: Samuel Hoare Junior, John Barton and William Dillwyn. Clarkson went on to help win the Slave Trade Act, which ended British trade in slaves in eighteen oh seven. Sharp had defended an injured enslaved man in court as early as seventeen sixty-seven. The abolition of slavery itself in British colonies followed in eighteen thirty-three.
